AI PROGRAM — INTERDISCIPLINARY ELECTIVE COURSE LISTS
Curated October 2026

These lists populate the restricted elective dropdowns for the example AI program (cache/99).
Two categories: FSSH (AI in the Social Sciences & Humanities) and FBIT (AI in Business & IT).
All courses drawn from the 2024-2025 Ontario Tech calendar (catoid 92).

================================================================================
FSSH — AI IN THE SOCIAL SCIENCES & HUMANITIES (8 courses)
================================================================================

COMM 2311U  The Creative Industries: Ideas, Art, Tech, Money, Power
  Level:    2nd year
  Prereqs:  None
  Notes:    Stepping stone — satisfies an FSSH elective and unlocks COMM 4140U.
            Students can take this in year 1-2 and COMM 4140U later for a second
            FSSH credit; the prereq course itself earns elective credit.

COMM 2620U  Professional Communication and AI
  Level:    2nd year
  Prereqs:  Credit restriction with COMM 2600U only (no course prereq)
  Notes:    AI-focused writing and communication; accessible from year 1.

COMM 4120U  AI, Ethics and Communication
  Level:    4th year
  Prereqs:  BSc 4th-year standing
  Notes:    AI students will have this standing by year 4 — no additional barrier.

COMM 4140U  Ways of Seeing: Immersive Communication and AI
  Level:    4th year
  Prereqs:  COMM 2311U
  Notes:    COMM 2311U is also on this list. Students who take 2311U as an FSSH
            elective can then take this as a second FSSH elective in year 3-4.

POSC 3700U  Technology, Politics and Social Theory
  Level:    3rd year
  Prereqs:  One introductory POSC course
  FLAG:     Students wishing to take this should plan to use a general elective
            slot in year 1-2 for an introductory POSC course (e.g. POSC 1000U).

LGLS 3520U  Law and Technology
  Level:    3rd year
  Prereqs:  3rd-year standing only
  Notes:    No course-specific prereqs; any AI student in year 3+ can take this.

EDST 2180U  AI in Education
  Level:    2nd year
  Prereqs:  EDST 1000U
  FLAG:     Students wishing to take this should plan to use a general elective
            slot for EDST 1000U first. Directly relevant to AI in learning contexts.

INDG 4570U  Indigenous Design and Technology
  Level:    4th year
  Prereqs:  None
  Notes:    Unique offering addressing Indigenous perspectives on AI/technology.

================================================================================
FBIT — AI IN BUSINESS & IT (6 courses)
================================================================================

BUSI 2800U  Fundamentals of AI for Business
  Level:    2nd year
  Prereqs:  None
  Notes:    Anchor course — no prerequisites. Taking this in year 1-2 unlocks
            the full BUSI AI chain (3830U, 4800U, 4801U).

BUSI 3830U  AI Beyond the Hype
  Level:    3rd year
  Prereqs:  BUSI 2800U
  Notes:    BUSI 2800U is on this list; students can chain both across FBIT slots.

BUSI 4800U  Business Applications of AI
  Level:    4th year
  Prereqs:  BUSI 2800U
  Notes:    Senior FBIT elective; same prereq chain as 3830U. Alternative to 4801U.

BUSI 4801U  Special Topics in AI for Business
  Level:    4th year
  Prereqs:  BUSI 2800U
  Notes:    Variable content each offering; prereq met via 2800U.

INFR 2310U  Animation and A.I. for Games
  Level:    2nd year
  Prereqs:  GAME 1100U or (INFR 1100U + INFR 1200U)
  FLAG:     Game development prereqs not in the AI program core. Included with the
            expectation that a formal prereq amendment will be pursued for AI
            students who have equivalent math and programming background.

INFR 4320U  Artificial Intelligence for Gaming
  Level:    4th year
  Prereqs:  3rd-year standing only
  Notes:    No course-specific prereqs; covers a distinct AI application domain.

================================================================================
CHAINING NOTES
================================================================================

BUSI 2800U chain:
  A student using all 3 FBIT slots optimally: 2800U (year 1-2), 3830U (year 2-3),
  and 4800U or 4801U (year 4). All three slots covered with a coherent AI-in-business
  sequence, no extra prereq courses needed.

COMM 2311U -> COMM 4140U chain:
  Both courses are on the FSSH list. A student takes 2311U early (FSSH slot 1)
  and 4140U later (FSSH slot 2 or 3). The prereq course itself earns elective credit —
  no "wasted" slot for the prereq.

POSC 3700U / EDST 2180U:
  Both require a single introductory prereq course not in the AI core. Students
  who want either of these should budget one general elective slot for the prereq.
  They should not both be pursued unless the student has enough general elective
  budget to cover two additional prereq courses.
